title: Patient Financial Assistance Program Award Discount: The Amount Worked On When an Invoice Carries Adjustments
content:
**Rule.** The amount a Patient Financial Assistance Program award discount works on (its working amount) depends on the adjustments posted on the invoice. The working amount is the amount from which the household's owed share is figured and from which the award discount is taken.

- **An invoice carrying a courtesy adjustment** works on the patient responsibility posted less only its billing-error corrections and estimate-dispute settlements, its courtesy and small-balance adjustments being applied after the award discount.
- **An invoice carrying no courtesy adjustment but a billing-error correction** works on the patient responsibility posted less only its billing-error corrections.
- **Any other invoice**: this rule does not alter the amount the award discount works on.

## Condition, judgement, result

| Courtesy adjustment posted on the invoice | Billing-error correction posted on the invoice | Working amount |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes or no | Patient responsibility posted, less billing-error corrections, less estimate-dispute settlements |
| No | Yes | Patient responsibility posted, less billing-error corrections |
| No | No | Not altered by this rule |

## Cases (hypothetical invoices)

Each invoice has $500.00 of patient responsibility posted.

1. Adjustments posted: a courtesy adjustment of $50.00, a billing-error correction of $30.00, an estimate-dispute settlement of $20.00 and a small-balance write-off of $5.00. Working amount: $500.00 less $30.00 less $20.00, which is $450.00. The $50.00 courtesy adjustment and the $5.00 write-off are applied after the award discount, not before it.
2. Adjustments posted: a billing-error correction of $30.00 and an estimate-dispute settlement of $20.00, no courtesy adjustment. Working amount: $500.00 less $30.00, which is $470.00; the estimate-dispute settlement is not taken off.
3. Adjustments posted: an estimate-dispute settlement of $20.00 only. Neither a courtesy adjustment nor a billing-error correction is posted, so this rule does not alter the working amount.
